collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: A storyteller wonders whether distant societies can spread one song, rumor, or picture to thousands of people at once.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A storyteller wonders whether distant societies can spread one song, rumor, or picture to thousands of people at once.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The village stages a lively imitation of a broadcast, with runners carrying the same announcement.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Each runner changes a detail; the storyteller marvels at how easily messages drift.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Researchers speculate about rapid signaling across enormous distances.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A mediator worries that false accusations could travel faster than corrections.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The group discusses the importance of many independent voices and verifiable evidence.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A shy villager notes that being heard by everyone could feel terrifying rather than empowering.
